offering_description.value: Provides management and technology consulting, engineering, analytics, cyber, AI and digital solutions primarily to the U.S. federal government. Delivers through teams of consultants, engineers and technologists working on client missions under contracts.

primary_services.value: management consulting; cybersecurity services; artificial intelligence and data analytics; systems engineering and IT modernization; digital solutions integration

customer_segment.value: B2G: U.S. Defense Department, intelligence community, civil agencies, and allied governments; B2B: limited commercial and international clients

end_markets.value: defense; intelligence; civil government; health; national security

revenue_model.value: project or contract: cost-plus, time-and-materials and fixed-price government contracts; service fees: consulting and technical staff labor billed to agencies

value_chain_position.value: service provider: supplies professional talent and technology expertise to government agencies as prime or subcontractor

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States with some work for allied governments in the Middle East and elsewhere

specialization.value: related lines: consulting, cyber, analytics, AI, engineering and digital services for government missions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bids and contract vehicles with federal agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: federal procurement rules (FAR), security clearances, export controls and government contract audits
